name: Loco Pilot
title: Railway Loco Pilot (RRB ALP)
intro: From Class 10 to driving Mail/Express trains: an ITI trade or engineering diploma from the RRB list, the RRB ALP CBT-1, CBT-2 and CBAT, the A-1 medical, then training as Assistant Loco Pilot and promotion through goods and passenger trains.

phases.title: Class 10 and the medical check
phases.summary: Any board; check the A-1 medical standard before you prepare.
points: Class 10 pass from any board is the base; Maths and Science basics help in the exam.
The A-1 medical standard includes vision standards without glasses that rule out many candidates.
Get tested early — candidates who fail A-1 cannot be appointed even after clearing every exam.
phases.tip: Read the medical section of the current RRB ALP notification and get your eyes tested before you start preparing.

phases.title: ITI or engineering diploma
phases.summary: A trade or branch named in the RRB ALP notification.
points: An ITI from NCVT/SCVT in a listed trade (for example Electrician, Fitter, Mechanic Diesel), or a Course Completed Act Apprenticeship in those trades.
Or a diploma/degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics or Automobile Engineering, or another branch the notification lists.
Age limits and category relaxations are fixed in each RRB ALP notification.

phases.title: RRB ALP CBT-1 and CBT-2
phases.summary: A qualifying screening test, then Part A for merit and a qualifying trade Part B.
points: CBT-1: maths, reasoning, general science and general awareness — qualifying only, marks do not count in final merit.
CBT-2 Part A (maths, reasoning, science, awareness) counts for merit.
CBT-2 Part B is a qualifying trade test for your ITI/diploma field.

phases.title: CBAT, documents and medical
phases.summary: Psychometric aptitude tests, document verification and the A-1 medical.
points: The Computer Based Aptitude Test checks memory, concentration, perception and reaction for train driving.
You must clear the minimum score in each test battery.
Document verification and the A-1 medical follow.

phases.title: Training and promotions
phases.summary: Initial training, then ALP; promotion to goods, passenger and Mail/Express.
points: Assistant Loco Pilot pay: Level 2 of the 7th CPC matrix (₹19,900 entry basic), plus DA, HRA and running allowance.
Growth path: ALP → Sr ALP → Loco Pilot (Shunter/Goods) → Passenger → Mail/Express → Loco Inspector; promotion is seniority-based and takes many years.
Metro rail corporations hire train operators separately.
